details: TERRATREND — Earth Systems Intelligence Platform1. What the Project Does & Core GoalsProject Overview: TerraTrend is an advanced Earth systems intelligence and environmental analytics platform designed to bridge the critical gap between raw, complex NASA satellite archives and immediate, actionable scientific insights.Core Goals:Democratize Environmental Data: Enable any researcher, student, or decision-maker to explore multi-decadal climate trends for any location worldwide with a single click.Statistical Rigor: Move beyond superficial forecasts or unverified AI claims by implementing standardized, peer-reviewed environmental statistical tests.Scientific Traceability: Automatically link environmental findings to real, peer-reviewed academic literature to ensure total transparency and reproducibility.2. How It Works (The Technical Pipeline)The platform operates on a robust, deterministic data pipeline:Geographic Resolution: The user selects a location or coordinates, and the system uses GeoNames and high-resolution digital elevation models (AWS Terrain Tiles) to establish comprehensive topographic context. Live NASA Data Retrieval: The backend queries the N retrieving authentic academic references and research papers.GeoNames & Natural Earth: For handling spatial boundaries and geographical nomenclature.
